title: Enterprise Connectivity: assessed net computation
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this assessed net computation rule to accepted-source pricing.

## Basis: outcome
For accepted-source pricing, reduce the entire unreduced transfer subtotal once by that selected fraction, cap it at the accepted net ceiling, and round only the computed assessed net half-up to the source-tier monetary precision. The record is an approved correct invoice assessment and makes no receivable change.

## Basis Q&A
**What governs accepted-source pricing here?** Reduce the entire unreduced transfer subtotal once by that selected fraction, cap it at the accepted net ceiling, and round only the computed assessed net half-up to the source-tier monetary precision. The record is an approved correct invoice assessment and makes no receivable change.

## Hypothetical calculation
Assume a hypothetical unreduced subtotal of USD 101, selected reduction fraction 0.08, authorized net ceiling USD 90 and two-decimal precision. Reducing the whole subtotal gives USD 92.92, then applying the permission ceiling gives USD 90. Reducing the ceiling instead would give USD 82.80 and would not follow this order.
